# Bloch generated files untracked (2026-10-08)

The bloch codebase map files `.ai/memory/bloch-last.json` and `.ai/memory/bloch-summary.md` are no longer tracked in git. The post-commit hook (`scripts/hooks/post-commit`) used to regenerate them after every commit and amend them into it, so two generated files rode along in unrelated commits, caused the only conflict in the level-select rebase, and churned ~19k lines through diffs. Fix: `git rm --cached` on both (they stay on disk), precise `.gitignore` entries, and the hook no longer regenerates or stages them — it keeps only the curated-memory reminder. The map is a local artifact: regenerate on demand with `bloch . --update-memory` (bloch also reads `bloch-last.json` as its `--diff` cache, which keeps working locally). Authored memory is unchanged: INDEX.md, current.md, decisions.md, patterns.md, inbox notes still commit exactly as before. Census at the time: only light-show tracked these files (phlow never did; its `.ai/memory/` has no bloch artifacts and no hook); the primo .GH mirror and scratch clones inherit the untracking on their next pull.
